shots.scene: 欣欣站在直流电路板前，板上三盏小灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a powered off direct current circuit board with three small lamps and two loops highlighted, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十八课：基尔霍夫定律与功率传输。
overlay: 基尔霍夫定律与功率传输

shots.scene: 阿杰接好线，电源开着，正要把电压旋钮拧大
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes wiring a circuit board while the power supply is already switched on and turns the voltage knob up fast, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：线接好了，电压直接拧上去！

shots.scene: 小研按住他的手，指着电源恒流指示灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops his hand and points at a glowing indicator lamp on the power supply, a crossed out live wiring icon.
shots.narration: 小研：通着电接线？先断电！

shots.scene: 王老师拿着电路图走来
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks over holding a blank circuit diagram sheet and a checklist icon.
shots.narration: 王老师：先算理论值，查过再合闸。

shots.section_title: 本课实验：算一遍测一遍
shots.scene: 同一电路，计算本和电表并列
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one direct current circuit in the middle, a calculator notebook on the left and meters on the right, an equal sign between them. No text.
shots.narration: 同一个直流电路，算一遍，测一遍。
overlay: 本课实验：算一遍测一遍

shots.section_title: 本课实验：算一遍测一遍
shots.scene: 实物实验和仿真实验两条路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a real circuit bench and a computer screen with a simulated circuit, both pointing to two law icons. No text.
shots.narration: 实物实验和虚拟仿真，都来验证。

shots.section_title: 本课实验：算一遍测一遍
shots.scene: 最后一部分：最大功率传输
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a source with an internal resistor feeding a variable load resistor, a power curve with a peak. No text.
shots.narration: 最后学最大功率传输定理。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a straight line graph of voltage against current through a resistor, a thermometer icon held constant. No text.
shots.narration: 温度不变，电压和电流成正比。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an insulator block and a semiconductor diode with a curved graph, a not applicable icon. No text.
shots.narration: 绝缘体、半导体不遵守欧姆定律。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: resistors in series, in parallel and in a series parallel combination, three small panels. No text.
shots.narration: 电阻有串联、并联和混联三种接法。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: resistors connected end to start in one chain, the same current arrow through each. No text.
shots.narration: 串联尾接头，电流处处相同。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltage split across two series resistors in proportion to their resistance. No text.
shots.narration: 各段电压不同，用分压公式求。

shots.scene: 并联：头接头尾接尾，电压相同
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: resistors connected start to start and end to end, the same voltage across each branch. No text.
shots.narration: 并联头接头、尾接尾，电压相同。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a total current dividing into two branches, the smaller resistor taking the larger current. No text.
shots.narration: 支路电流用分流公式求。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a junction node with three current arrows in and out, the sums balanced. No text.
shots.narration: 节点上，流进的电流等于流出的。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water pipe splitting into two branches, the water amount the same before and after. No text.
shots.narration: 像水管分岔，水不会凭空变多变少。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a main current splitting into two branch currents that add up to it. No text.
shots.narration: 本实验里，干路电流等于两支路之和。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed loop with a source and two resistors, arrows of voltage rise and drop cancelling. No text.
shots.narration: 闭合回路里，电压代数和为零。

shots.scene: 电动势之和等于电压降之和
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a staircase going up at the source and down across two resistors back to the start level. No text.
shots.narration: 电动势之和，等于电压降之和。

shots.scene: 电源电压等于两段之和
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the source voltage equal to the voltage of the first lamp plus the voltage of the parallel part. No text.
shots.narration: 本实验里，电源电压等于两段之和。

shots.scene: 【实拍】认识稳压电源、三盏灯、电流表和万用表
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a powered off regulated direct current supply, three identical small lamps on a board, three direct current ammeters and a multimeter on a bench.
shots.narration: 稳压电源、三盏同样的灯，各就位。

shots.scene: 三只电流表，三只电压表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three direct current ammeters and three direct current voltmeters in a row. No text.
shots.narration: 三只直流电流表，三只直流电压表。

shots.scene: 没有电压表用万用表直流挡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multimeter switched to the direct voltage position replacing the voltmeters. No text.
shots.narration: 电压表不够，用万用表直流电压挡。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lamp two and lamp three in parallel, then in series with lamp one across the supply. No text.
shots.narration: 灯二灯三并联，再和灯一串联。

shots.scene: 电流表测干路和两支路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one ammeter in the main line and one ammeter in each parallel branch. No text.
shots.narration: 三只电流表，测干路和两条支路。

shots.scene: 电压表测电源、灯1和并联部分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: voltmeters across the supply, across lamp one and across the parallel part. No text.
shots.narration: 电压表测电源、灯一和并联部分。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a circuit diagram with plus and minus marks at every meter, an alternating circuit without marks. No text.
shots.narration: 直流电路图要标正负，交流不用。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电状态下指认直流表正负端子
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a finger pointing to the red positive and black negative terminals of a direct current ammeter on a powered off board.
shots.narration: 直流表正进负出，正端接高电位。

shots.scene: 接反指针反打，断电改接
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a meter needle swinging below zero, a power off icon, then the leads swapped. No text.
shots.narration: 接反指针反打，立即断电再改接。

shots.scene: 先画理论值和实测值两套表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two blank tables side by side, one marked with a calculator icon and one with a meter icon. No text.
shots.narration: 先画两套表：理论值和实测值。

shots.scene: 第一步：额定值求灯电阻
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp rating of voltage and power turned into resistance by a formula. No text.
shots.narration: 第一步，用灯的额定值求电阻。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two parallel resistors merged into one and added to the series resistor. No text.
shots.narration: 第二步，并联合起来再加串联。

shots.scene: 第三步：总电流和分流，验证KCL
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: supply voltage divided by the equivalent resistance, then split into two equal branch currents. No text.
shots.narration: 第三步，求总电流再分流，验KCL。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the first lamp voltage from current times resistance, the rest across the parallel part, adding up to the supply. No text.
shots.narration: 第四步，求两段电压，验KVL。

shots.scene: 算出的电流帮助选量程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calculated current value pointing to the matching ammeter range on a selector. No text.
shots.narration: 算出的电流，帮你选好量程。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a measured value far from the calculated one, a power off icon, a magnifier over the wiring and the meters. No text.
shots.narration: 实测差太多，先断电查线查表。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dual output regulated supply with one output used, a crossed out icon of the two outputs linked by the student. No text.
shots.narration: 双路电源用一路，不自行串并联。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a coarse voltage knob, a fine voltage knob and a current limit knob on a supply panel. No text.
shots.narration: 粗调大步走，细调微调，另有限流旋钮。

shots.scene: 【实拍】开机前电压旋钮旋到最小
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand turning the coarse and fine voltage knobs of a powered off regulated supply fully counterclockwise to minimum.
shots.narration: 开机前，两个电压旋钮旋到最小。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a current limit knob set just above the expected current, a teacher icon nodding, a display switch between volts and amps. No text.
shots.narration: 限流按预估电流和老师要求设好。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a supply main switch in the off position, a wiring hand icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 接线时，电源总开关一定是关的。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电后从电源正极出发先串后并接线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands connecting leads from the positive output of a powered off supply to an ammeter and lamp one, then the two parallel branches.
shots.narration: 从正极出发，先串后并，回到负极。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the series loop complete first, then a voltmeter clipped across a lamp last. No text.
shots.narration: 串联回路接好，最后并电压表。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the wiring on the powered off board with a checklist, then the female graduate student switches the supply on.
shots.narration: 请老师检查，确认无误再合闸。

shots.section_title: 调压不超额定，拨直流挡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a supply display rising slowly from zero to a set value with the coarse then fine knob. No text.
shots.narration: 合闸后从零慢慢调到设定电压。
overlay: 调压不超额定，拨直流挡

shots.section_title: 调压不超额定，拨直流挡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltage arrow stopping below the lamp rating line, a burnt lamp and a bent needle crossed out above it. No text.
shots.narration: 电压不超过灯和电表的额定值。

shots.section_title: 调压不超额定，拨直流挡
shots.scene: 【实拍】万用表拨到直流电压挡
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand turning a multimeter dial to the direct voltage position, probes not connected.
shots.narration: 万用表拨直流电压挡，别拨交流挡。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multimeter across lamp one then across the parallel part, the two readings added to match the supply. No text.
shots.narration: 测灯一和并联部分，相加约等于电源。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three ammeter needles, the two branch readings adding up to the main reading, the lower scale used on the small range. No text.
shots.narration: 读三路电流，小量程读对应刻度。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two nearly equal values with a small difference, meter tolerance and component tolerance icons. No text.
shots.narration: 元件和电表有误差，差一点正常。

shots.scene: 每人一个电压，各测一组
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several students each choosing a different supply voltage and recording one row in the table. No text.
shots.narration: 换几个电压，组员各测一组。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the voltage knob back to zero, the supply switched off and unplugged, the lamps left to cool. No text.
shots.narration: 做完旋钮回零，断电拔插头。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a supply panel with a constant voltage indicator and a constant current indicator, the second glowing. No text.
shots.narration: 电源有恒压、恒流两个指示灯。

shots.scene: 恒流亮可能短路，断电查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short circuit spark icon on the board, a power off icon, a magnifier over the wiring. No text.
shots.narration: 恒流灯亮可能短路，先断电查清。

shots.scene: 在学校指定平台找到实验
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a computer screen showing a blank simulation platform page with a circuit icon card. No text.
shots.narration: 在学校指定平台找到基尔霍夫实验。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of blank tabs with icons for aim, theory, pretest and procedure with a wiring diagram. No text.
shots.narration: 页面有目的、原理和步骤栏目。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student reads a theory page on a laptop and answers a short multiple choice pretest, a checkmark icon.
shots.narration: 先读原理，做预习测试打好基础。

shots.scene: 拖动节点连线，电压表并联
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simulated circuit with a mouse cursor dragging a wire from a voltmeter to both ends of a resistor. No text.
shots.narration: 鼠标拖节点连线，电压表并在两端。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a check button pressed, a green correct icon popping up, then three resistor sliders adjusted. No text.
shots.narration: 先点检查，接线正确再设电阻。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simulated supply rising from zero, an add button putting rows into a table, six rows filled. No text.
shots.narration: 电压从零调起，每次添加，记六组。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plot of two rising straight lines, a print icon and a reset icon. No text.
shots.narration: 绘图看曲线，打印存档，复位重做。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: simulated ammeters inserted in series in each branch, a wrongly paralleled ammeter crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电流表必须串在支路里。

shots.scene: 按教材数值设电阻，记三个电流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: resistor sliders set to textbook values, three branch currents recorded for several voltages. No text.
shots.narration: 按教材数值设电阻，记三个电流。

shots.scene: 总电流等于支路和，打印交老师
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a total current equal to two branch currents added, a printed report handed to a teacher icon. No text.
shots.narration: 总电流等于支路和，打印交老师。

shots.scene: 仿真接错能重来，真电路不行
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simulation error popup with a retry arrow beside a real board with a burnt meter icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 仿真接错能重来，真电路会烧表。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laptop simulation predicting meter readings, an arrow to choosing ranges on a real bench. No text.
shots.narration: 先仿真预演，估读数、选量程。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a real powered off board before the young male student switches on, a training certificate icon beside them.
shots.narration: 上台实操，照样培训、检查再通电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery with a small internal resistor drawn in series inside a dashed box. No text.
shots.narration: 电源内部有电阻，画成串联。

shots.scene: 负载等于内阻时功率最大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a load resistor knob turned, a power curve rising to a peak where the load equals the internal resistance. No text.
shots.narration: 负载电阻等于内阻，得到功率最大。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the power curve low at both a very small and a very large load, the peak in the middle. No text.
shots.narration: 负载太大太小，功率都上不去。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an equivalent source voltage squared divided by four times the internal resistance. No text.
shots.narration: 最大功率等于电压平方除以四倍内阻。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power pie split in half, one half heating the internal resistor and one half reaching the load. No text.
shots.narration: 匹配时，效率只有百分之五十。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power grid transmission line with a high efficiency gauge, a matching icon crossed out beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 一半耗在电源内部，电网不按匹配用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solar panel under changing sunlight with a tracking controller keeping the output at the peak of its curve. No text.
shots.narration: 光伏跟踪控制器，随时找功率最高点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an audio amplifier connected to a loudspeaker with a matching icon. No text.
shots.narration: 功放带音箱，也讲究阻抗匹配。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a radio receiver with a tuning dial and an antenna, a matching icon. No text.
shots.narration: 收音机调谐，也用到匹配的思想。

shots.scene: KCL节点流入等于流出，KVL回路和为零
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a node with balanced current arrows and a loop with cancelling voltage arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 节点电流守恒，回路电压和为零。

shots.scene: 归零限流、断电接线、检查后合闸
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a knob at zero, a current limit icon, a power off plug and a teacher check icon in sequence. No text.
shots.narration: 旋钮归零设限流，断电接线查后合闸。

shots.scene: 匹配功率最大，效率一半
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power curve peak where the load equals the internal resistance and a half filled efficiency gauge. No text.
shots.narration: 负载等于内阻功率最大，效率一半。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台关着门的桌面激光切割机旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed desktop laser cutter with its lid shut and a fume extraction duct attached, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：激光切割机操作（桌面与工业）。
